name: 30th Street Station District Plan
description: Long-term redevelopment of the area around 30th Street Station. Includes air-rights development over the rail yards, station infrastructure upgrades, and Schuylkill Yards (Drexel/Brandywine).

name: I-95 Cap at Penn's Landing
description: 11-acre cap over I-95 and Columbus Boulevard connecting Old City and Society Hill to the Delaware waterfront. Includes parks, plazas, and pedestrian connections.

name: Rebuild: Recreation, Parks, Libraries
description: Citywide capital program funded by the sugary drink tax. ~$500M reinvestment across 60+ rec centers, parks, and libraries. Pool rebuilds, branch library renovations, playground replacements.
funding_source: Philadelphia Beverage Tax + William Penn Foundation

name: Baldi Middle School Replacement
description: Demolition and replacement of C.C.A. Baldi Middle School in Bustleton. New 1,200-student facility with full geothermal HVAC.
funding_source: School District of Philadelphia Capital Program

name: FDR Park Plan
description: Complete redesign of FDR Park including a new athletic complex (12 fields), restored tidal wetlands, expanded SEPA hiking trail, and a Welcome Center. Largest park investment in city history.
funding_source: Philadelphia Parks + Rec + Fairmount Park Conservancy

name: Vine Street Expressway Cap
description: Proposed deck cap over I-676 between Broad and 8th Streets. Would reconnect Center City to Chinatown, which was bisected when the expressway was cut through in the 1990s.

name: Roosevelt Boulevard Multimodal Project
description: Reconfiguration of US-1 between Broad Street and Bucks County line. Bus rapid transit, protected bike lanes, pedestrian islands at every intersection. Most dangerous road in Pennsylvania.

name: Green City, Clean Waters
description: 25-year green stormwater infrastructure program. Bioswales, permeable pavement, green roofs, rain gardens across 10,000 'greened acres' to manage combined sewer overflows.
